connector.name: ComfyUI Builder
connector.registryDescription: ComfyUI MCP server: knowledge base, workflow builder, real-time execution, models, plugins.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-comfy-ui-builder. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mit9 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: COMFYUI_HOST
env.description: ComfyUI API URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8188). Required for execution, queue, outputs.

env.name: COMFYUI_PATH
env.description: Path to ComfyUI install. Required for install_custom_node, install_model.

env.name: COMFYUI_KNOWLEDGE_DIR
env.description: Path to knowledge directory (default: package knowledge/). Use when MCP runs from different cwd.
